the same age-limit event and should not be counted as separate independent evidence units.","EAF and BTI political interpretations require separation from factual 2023 conduct and causal recoverability.","Several EAF items still use broad article-level locators and should be tied to precise claim locations.","Policy ownership, macro outcomes, and distributional effects remain insufficiently separated causally.","The WTO record documents an international legal outcome but does not by itself establish the ruler's economic effectiveness.","The chapter remains thin on regional and human-development outcomes for 2023."]},{"attribution_risk":"high","chapter_id":"6B","defensible_evidence_estimate":7,"independent_source_family_estimate":6,"missing_themes":["Direct attribution ruler-attributed conduct.","The BRIN criticism and BRIN counter-publication require separate claim units and neutral treatment; neither establishes a complete presidential effectiveness chain.","The incomplete.","The local-fact field-level disposition and lens mapping are still not explicitly evidence concerning presidential transparency and correction"],"substantive_issues":["The interim KPK appointment and anti-corruption speech provide direct corrective and stated-recognition evidence, but official self-statements require caution.","Firli's alleged conduct and the minister-investigation count do not establish Jokowi's personal integrity without knowledge, benefit, tolerance, or obstruction evidence.","The Firli appointment and KPK reform remain cross-period institutional evidence rather than target-period personal conduct.","Repeated reports of the same Firli episode should not count as independent claims or source families.","The asset-disclosure and personal-enrichment search gap remains research-recoverable and outside flagship projects","Clear separation of presidential targets, implementation metrics, and later outcomes"],"substantive_issues":["The official Whoosh and IKN records add target-period delivery metrics and presidential program ownership.","Official statements and ministry-reported progress are not independent evaluations of delivery quality, cost, or effectiveness.","SOE debt, ecological effects, military involvement, and BRIN dysfunction require explicit responsibility links rather than automatic attribution to Jokowi.","The BRIN publication is useful contrary evidence but does not resolve the broader performance dispute.","No documented 2023 corrective action after a failure has been recovered."]}],"global_findings":["All permitted research and review rounds were exhausted independent evaluation, contrary evidence, target-period outcomes, and corrective adaptation.","Gateway-only material, same-event corroboration, official self-assessment, and duplicated chapter copies must remain excluded from defensible counts.","Stable global IDs, deduplication, many-to-many lens mappings, count reconciliation, and the explicit local-fact field-level disposition audit remain unproven in the handoff.","Missing evidence has not been treated as negative ruler evidence."],"needs_continuation":false,"reviewer_summary":"Terminal evidence-quality review completed after all
